Your vehicle [color=#ff6666]#1#[/color].

It [color=#ff6666]#2#[/color] and towed back to the nearest garage.

All deliveries were cancelled and the service cost [color=#ff6666]$500.00[/color].

Press [icon=Space] to continue.

Your goal is to pick up and deliver packages. [color=#ffdf87]Delivery requests[/color] appear on the left side of the screen. Accepting one displays its pickup and drop-off locations at the top, along with the time limit.

Most controls appear on-screen, but these are the key ones:

[icon=Up] [icon=Down] accelerate and brake
[icon=Left] [icon=Right] turn left and right
[icon=Space] interact with shops
[icon=Y] [icon=N] accept/decline requests
[icon=M] toggle music and sound

Collisions and driving over dirt damage your vehicle, which you can fix at the [color=#ffdf87]repair shop[/color]. Moving around also consumes fuel. You can refill at [color=#ffdf87]gas stations[/color]. If your car breaks down or runs out of fuel, a $500 service fee tows it back to the nearest [color=#ffdf87]garage[/color].

You can buy or switch vehicles at any interactable spot using [icon=n1][icon=n2][icon=n3]. The [color=#ffdf87]sedan[/color] is the fastest, the [color=#ffdf87]pickup truck[/color] takes minimal dirt damage, and the [color=#ffdf87]compact[/color] turns in place for high maneuverability.

Check or reset your progress at any [color=#ffdf87]garage[/color]. Complete all achievements to beat the game.

[color=#ffdf87]Happy delivering![/color]
